segments.summary: Defines FileSafe ownership, fail-closed policy, and override authority, but the custom-pattern constructor path can replace rather than extend the canonical baseline.
The core matcher and loader omit independent dispatch-segment enforcement and accept an empty destructive-pattern set with only a warning.
Provider integration contains an unreceipted verification-gate bypass and incomplete create-path handling; fallback-state truth is misleading, while canonical event ownership is explicit.
The mutation CAS contract is strong, but tests, checklist authority, event naming, unknown filesystem handling, and disabled SecurityFilter behavior leave exploitable or misleading paths.

Compiled-context safety specifies visible attachment failure truth, but Unicode parsing, lexical path checks, ignored event-write failures, stale override guidance, and implicit attachment write authority remain severe gaps.

The final integration and GUI material fixes placement but contains multiple authority bypasses, lossy command and path discovery, fail-open interview defaults, unbounded state, and under-specified cleanup behavior.
